title: Codex Release Manifest
description: Bound manifest that the publish lane must carry. SD-16 / Tranche 2.x doctrine requires both tranche_id and release_notes_path to be present, structurally valid, and consistent before any tester-channel publication can succeed. The publish workflow must refuse to attach a release whose manifest does not satisfy this schema.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. v1 enforces tranche_id + release_notes_path binding.

tranche_id.description: Identifier of the governing tranche (e.g. 'tranche-2.5'). Must match a directory under docs/release/ (relocated 2026-07-20 from programs/codex/requirements/).

release_notes_path.description: Repo-relative path to the canonical tranche release-notes.md file. Must begin with 'docs/release/' and end with 'release-notes.md'. The referenced file MUST exist on the merged branch and contain every required section (Summary, User-Visible Changes, Defects Fixed, Operational Notes, Verification Evidence, Known Issues, Update Eligibility). Relocated 2026-07-20 from programs/codex/requirements/; manifests published before that date reference the old path and are not retroactively updated.

spec_domain_id.description: Optional explicit SD-NN reference for the spec domain this release primarily delivers. Must match the dirname under docs/release/ that release_notes_path points into.

platform_artifacts.description: Per-platform artifact declarations. Each entry must reference an artifact actually produced by the publish lane (deb / AppImage / etc).

update_eligibility.description: Per-platform update eligibility outcome. Only Linux first-class may be 'automatic' on this tranche.

publication_run_id.description: CI run id that produced this manifest. Usually left blank in source-controlled manifests and rewritten by the publish workflow.
